# Test fixtures

Small, syntactically valid repositories used by the analyzer, validator, renderer and journey tests.
They are **not** git repositories: tests copy a fixture into a temp dir and run `git init` + commit
there so commit pinning and diff tracking can be exercised deterministically.

Families with a README of their own, one tiny app per framework or shape:
[`api-frameworks/`](api-frameworks/README.md) (HTTP contracts),
[`orm-models/`](orm-models/README.md), [`flows/`](flows/README.md),
[`client-drift/`](client-drift/README.md), [`attribution/`](attribution/README.md).

| Fixture | Language(s) | Exercises |
|---------|-------------|-----------|
| `polyglot-shop/` | TS, Go, Python, Rust | Demo repo. Unit detection across `package.json`, `go.mod`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`; `docker-compose.yml` `build:` → unit mapping, `depends_on` and URL-valued `environment` edges (`http://payments:8080`, `postgres://…@db`, `redis://redis`, `kafka:9092`); `image:` services → Postgres / Redis / Redpanda nodes; dependency classification (express, ioredis, kafkajs, pg, stripe-go, pgx, confluent-kafka, psycopg, sendgrid, sqlx, axum, react, vite); write vs read detection (`INSERT`/`UPDATE` in api-gateway, payments, fulfillment; `SELECT`-only in ledger-audit); Kafka producer (`producer.send({ topic: "order.placed" })`) and consumer (`subscribe(["order.placed"])`); entry points in every language; web client `fetch(\`${VITE_API_URL}/checkout\`)`. Critical path: web → api-gateway → payments → Stripe. |
| `rust-mini/` | Rust | Binary crate with `mod config; mod report; mod tokenizer;` and `use crate::…` imports; `fn main` entry point; doc comments; in-module `#[cfg(test)]`. No manifest dependencies. |
| `ts-mini/` | TypeScript | Fastify service with `listen(` entry in `src/index.ts`; relative imports (`./routes/notes`, `../store/notes-store`, `../types`); better-sqlite3 with `INSERT`/`DELETE` (writes). |
| `go-mini/` | Go | Module `example.com/urlshort`; `package main` + `func main` + `net/http`; intra-module imports of `internal/store`, `internal/handlers`, `internal/hash`. |
| `python-mini/` | Python | Flask app via `requirements.txt`; package-relative imports (`from .models import …`, `from . import models`); `if __name__ == "__main__":` entry; sqlite3 `INSERT` (writes). |
| `kotlin/spring-boot-kotlin/` | Kotlin | Spring Boot in Kotlin, Gradle Kotlin DSL: `@SpringBootApplication` + `runApplication<T>(*args)` entry; `server.servlet.context-path: /api`; `@RestController` + class `@RequestMapping`; `@RequestParam(defaultValue)` / `@PathVariable`; nullable types and Kotlin defaults as optional parameters; `@Valid @RequestBody` data class with `@field:` Bean Validation; `@ResponseStatus(CREATED)`; `ResponseStatusException`; `@PreAuthorize`; JPA `@Entity` / `@Table` / `@Column` / `@Enumerated` / `@ManyToOne`+`@JoinColumn` / `@OneToMany(mappedBy)`, a `@MappedSuperclass` and an `@Embeddable` flattened into the owning table; a Spring Data `JpaRepository` (derived finder + `@Modifying @Query`) and a `MongoRepository` over a `@Document` with `@Field` names; `publishEvent` / `@EventListener`; `@Scheduled` and `@KafkaListener`; an `orders.status` lifecycle. |
| `kotlin/exposed-ledger/` | Kotlin | JetBrains Exposed: `UUIDTable` / `IntIdTable` implicit keys, column builders with `.nullable()` / `.uniqueIndex()` / `.default(…)` / `.clientDefault { }`, `reference(…)` typed by the key it points at, `PrimaryKey(a, b)` composite keys, `insert {}` / `update {}` / `selectAll()` access, the DAO form (`UUIDEntityClass`) attributed through the entity class, and an `accounts.status` lifecycle whose initial state is the column default. |
| `kotlin/kotlin-modules/` | Kotlin | Gradle multi-module Kotlin: `include(":app", ":pricing")` root isn't a unit; `app` is an HTTP service, `pricing` stays a library although it holds a `@Service`; the `project(":pricing")` edge is cited at the `com.acme.pricing` import that uses it. Cross-service calls from Kotlin: a `@FeignClient` interface and a Ktor `HttpClient` call to a second module, with response drift on the Feign return type. |
| `kotlin/webflux-corouter/` | Kotlin | Spring WebFlux routed with the functional coroutine DSL: `coRouter { "/books".nest { GET("", handler::all) … } }` — the path comes from the nested block, the method reference names the handler, and the contract (params, `awaitBody<T>()`, `status(CREATED)`, `ResponseStatusException`) is read from the handler function; `spring.webflux.base-path`. |
| `real-world/compose-subdir/` | TS, Python | Immich-shaped: compose only in `docker/`; `build: {context: .., dockerfile: server/Dockerfile}` maps via Dockerfile dir; service named `shop-ml` → unit `ml`; default URL literal `http://shop-ml:3003` becomes server → ml; ML entry is the `FastAPI()` app, not the export script; Svelte web client linked to the server via `PUBLIC_API_URL`; workspace package `@shop/sdk`; `docs/` excluded. |
| `real-world/grpc-env-file/` | Go | wild-workouts-shaped: services share `docker/app` and a root `.env`; `trainer-grpc` → unit `trainer` by suffix; `TRAINER_GRPC_ADDR` read in library `common` only counts for units that call `NewTrainerClient` (trainings → trainer, gRPC); no self-edges from the shared env file. |
| `real-world/mostly-unread/` | Go, C++, Dart | A Go gateway of five readable files beside twelve C++ and four Dart ones — 5 of 21, so the scan warns that most of the repository was not read and the census names the languages most numerous first. Above the one-tenth floor, so it still produces a book; `polyglot-shop` is the control that reports nothing unread. |
| `real-world/unparsed-worker/` | Python, C#, Ruby | Voting-app-shaped. The C# worker is read from its own `Program.cs`, and is a worker rather than a CLI because compose runs it as a service with no published ports; the Ruby results page has no grammar, so it becomes a unit pinned to its Dockerfile with compose edges only, and is counted in the unread census. `request.cookies.get` is not a Redis read, `redis.rpush` is a write. |
| `real-world/rust-workspace/` | Rust | Lemmy-shaped: `[workspace]` root; six `crates/db_views/*` crates grouped into one node; `ws_utils` has lib + helper bin and is demoted to a library because others link it; `routes` depends on actix-web without an entry point (library); dev-dependency links ignored; primary path never walks into libraries. |
| `real-world/uv-workspace/` | Python, TS | FastAPI-template-shaped: uv workspace root isn't a unit; `scripts/` excluded; backend entry is `app = FastAPI()` over an `__main__` seeder; Alembic `UPDATE` ignored; SQLModel import yields backend → Postgres "queries"; npm package named `emails` isn't linked to the Python `emails` dependency; README summary skips badges/HTML. |
| `real-world/spring-cloud/` | Java | Piggymetrics-shaped: Maven aggregator (`<packaging>pom</packaging>` + `<modules>`) isn't a unit; `@SpringBootApplication` entry points; compose services use prebuilt `image:` only; Zuul gateway routes live in the Config Server's `shared/gateway.yml` (by `serviceId` and by URL host); `@FeignClient(name = "statistics-service")` resolves via `spring.application.name`; MongoDB and RabbitMQ from starters; `RabbitTemplate.convertAndSend` publishes, `@RabbitListener` consumes (in a package named `example`); bundled `src/main/resources/app.js` ignored; the config server is cross-cutting and left out of the figure, the gateway is focal; `common` (a `@KafkaListener` in a shared module, linked by artifactId) stays a library and its Kafka use is drawn on `stats`. |
| `real-world/spring-modulith/` | Java | Spring Modulith-shaped: base package `com.example` (not an examples dir); modules are packages below the application class, named by `package-info.java` Javadoc; `publishEvent(new OrderCompleted(…))` → `@ApplicationModuleListener` becomes an event edge order → inventory instead of an import edge; `main(String... args)` entry. |
| `real-world/go-mux-builder/` | Go | MinIO-shaped: a gorilla/mux fork (`github.com/minio/mux`) driven as a builder chain, `Methods(http.MethodGet).Path("/{object:.+}").HandlerFunc(apiMiddleware(api.GetObjectHandler)).Queries("tagging", "")` — the path is a link in the chain rather than an argument, the handler sits behind middleware, and two routes share a method and path so only the query tells them apart; `Subrouter()` prefixes resolve from a router parameter but not from one rebound by a `range` loop, which stays a partial path. |
| `real-world/spring-monorepo/` | Java, JS | Aggregator pom with two Spring services below it and a small JS helper at the root, which makes the root a unit: its empty config prefix matched every `application.yml`, so it claimed `account-service` and `gateway` as its own aliases and `@FeignClient("account-service")` in the gateway resolved to the root instead of the accounts service. |
| `real-world/go-hexagonal/` | Go | Wild-workouts- and mediatr-shaped: CQRS dispatch through a struct field chain (`h.app.Queries.AllTrainings.Handle`) that names no function, since `Handle` is declared on every handler; a `Repository` port resolved to its single adapter; a `*firestore.Client` field makes `r.client.Collection("trainings")` a store step cited at the call, not at `go.mod`; and a command bus (`mediatr.Send[*CreateOrder, *Res]`) resolved by the message type to the one method that takes it, since the call names the command and not the handler. |
| `real-world/k8s-deploy/` | Go, YAML | Runtime topology: root `docker-compose.yml` (build `./orders` → unit, published `8080:8080`, `depends_on`, healthcheck, named volume) with a `docker-compose.monitoring.yml` overlay (adds prometheus, changes orders); `k8s/` Deployment (replicas 3, namespace, probe, limits) selected by a Service (80→8080) behind an Ingress `shop.example.com/api`, a postgres StatefulSet and a CronJob running the same image; a Helm chart under `charts/orders/` whose values-only template renders (release name, image, `default 8080`) while its `{{- if }}` template is reported as not read. |
